bays.road: Bexley High Street car park, Bexley Village
bays.restriction: Council car park behind Nos. 40–84 High Street, Bexley, in two areas: short stay (north-western section, 59 spaces) and long stay (south-eastern section, 49 spaces). Season tickets available.
bays.tariff: Short-stay area (59 spaces, maximum stay 4 hours): up to 30 mins £0.90 by phone / £1.10 cash; up to 1 hr £1.60 by phone / £1.80 cash; up to 2 hrs £2.50 by phone / £2.70 cash; up to 4 hrs £3.90 by phone / £4.10 cash. Overnight: up to 6 hrs £1.30 by phone / £1.50 cash. Long-stay area (49 spaces): up to 30 mins £0.90 by phone / £1.10 cash; up to 1 hr £1.60 by phone / £1.80 cash; up to 2 hrs £2.50 by phone / £2.70 cash; up to 4 hrs £3.90 by phone / £4.10 cash; up to 10 hrs £6.00 by phone / £6.20 cash. Overnight: up to 6 hrs £1.30 by phone / £1.50 cash. Up to 24 hrs not available. Prices by phone exclude the provider's service charge (London Gazette notice 4925320, charges from 21 July 2025)
bays.pay: Pay by phone (prices exclude the service charge) or by cash at the machine
